scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const g=d=>!fs.existsSync(d)?[]:fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?g(d+'/'+e.name):e.name==='.vc-config.json'?[d+'/'+e.name]:[]);g('.vercel/output/functions').forEach(p=>{const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));c.runtime='nodejs24.x';fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(c,null,2));console.log('Patched runtime to nodejs24.x:',p);});"
